summary: Parses a locale/configuration string and either returns the stored default locale or commits a matched named locale into the global locale state. A null input returns null. An input equal to the ASCII string "C" (byte 67 followed by a null terminator) is treated as the built-in default locale: it zeroes the optional word and dword outputs and returns the caller-provided output buffer. Otherwise the input is matched against the two stored locale compare strings via sub_58FB90; on a successful match the input is parsed into a local buffer (sub_588F8B), validated against the locale data block (sub_58FD90), and the parsed result is committed into the stored locale buffers (sub_589057 / sub_58FCA0) with the conversion dword updated from word_8D3E4C. The optional word output receives six bytes of the locale data block and the optional dword output receives four bytes of the conversion value; the output buffer is normalized before the stored compare-string buffer is returned.

local_names.v5: local parse buffer for the matched locale

operations.description: Early-out: a null input string pointer returns null immediately
Default-locale fast path: when the first input byte equals 67 ('C') and the second byte is the null terminator, the input is the built-in default locale
Writes the default-locale marker into the output buffer a2: a 'C' byte followed by a null terminator
When the optional word output a3 is non-null, zeroes its three words
When the optional dword output a4 is non-null, zeroes the dword it points at
Returns the output buffer a2 on the default-locale path

Locale name matching: the input is compared against the stored compare string unk_5E6468 and the stored locale string unk_5E63E4 via sub_58FB90; both comparisons must succeed for the named-locale path
Parses the matched input into the local buffer v5 with sub_588F8B; a parse failure aborts the function
Validates the parsed buffer against the locale data block unk_8D3E48 via sub_58FD90; a validation failure aborts the function
Stores the low 16 bits of word_8D3E4C into dword_8D3E50 as the locale conversion result
Commits the parsed locale into the stored compare string unk_5E6468 via sub_589057 and normalizes the stored locale buffer unk_5E63E4 via sub_58FCA0
When the optional word output a3 is non-null, copies six bytes of the locale data block unk_8D3E48 into it via MemoryCopy_cc00
When the optional dword output a4 is non-null, copies four bytes of the conversion value dword_8D3E50 into it via MemoryCopy_cc00
Normalizes the output buffer a2 via sub_58FCA0 before returning
Returns the stored compare string buffer unk_5E6468 as the parse result

unresolved: The exact role and content layout of the two stored locale buffers unk_5E6468 and unk_5E63E4 are not defined here; one is the committed parse result and the other a comparison source, but their string encoding and lifetime are unknown
The meaning of the word_8D3E4C-to-dword_8D3E50 conversion value (a numeric locale identifier or code page) is not evidenced by this packet
Whether a1 is a NUL-terminated string or a fixed-length buffer is not evidenced; the 'C' fast path only probes the first two bytes
